note: Buyer-journey rules. Input is one row of multi_county_auctions using its real columns (see types/auctions.ts in zonewise-web). Output is the ordered list of trades the buyer needs; the game walks the buyer to one leased vendor per trade in the current county and counts a trade with no vendor as unmet demand.

rules.why: Larger lots are usually financed after the cash auction close.
Vacant land is a ground-up build: scout, clear, design, build.
Improved property gets inspected and appraised.
Older structures carry roof and wiring work on the Disposition stage.
Half an acre or more usually needs a boundary and drainage review.
Condo and townhouse buyers do not touch land or roof.
Tax deed buyers often need a quiet title action; attorney is already in always, kept here as the reason.
Income property goes to a manager at Hold.
A sold lot that the buyer flips lists with a broker at Exit.

order: by district order, then trade order within the district (see trades.json)

matching.policy: one leased vendor per trade in the lot's county; exclusive tier wins over standard; ties break by fewest matches so far
matching.unmet: a needed trade with no leased vendor in that county increments unmet[trade][county]; this list is the plot-lease sales queue
matching.studio: when the matched trade is architect and the lot is vacant land, the game offers the zonewise.ai Studio link for that lot
